"""Single registered outer native envelope for the first P3 train inference."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
MANIFEST = BASE / "frozen_source.json"
COMMAND = BASE / "command.json"
OUTER = BASE / "native_outer01"
INNER = BASE / "native_inner01"
WORKER = BASE / "run01/worker.json"
EXECUTION = BASE / "execution.json"


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def write_new(path, value):
    if path.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(path)
    temp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    with temp.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    temp.replace(path)


def source_hashes(manifest):
    expected = manifest["source"]
    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or not expected:
        raise ValueError("empty frozen source identity")
    required = {"experiments/closure_p3_disagreement_20261020.py",
                "experiments/native_process_receipt_20261020.ps1",
                "private_data/closure_mechanism_20261019/P3/first_disagreement_inference01/launch_once.py",
                "private_data/closure_mechanism_20261019/P3/first_disagreement_inference01/command.json",
                "reports/first_disagreement_inference_20261020_protocol.md",
                "reports/astra6_first_disagreement_inference_20261020.md"}
    if not required <= set(expected):
        raise ValueError("new stage source binding incomplete")
    actual = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in expected}
    if actual != expected:
        raise ValueError("frozen source identity mismatch")
    return actual


def command_identity():
    command = json.loads(COMMAND.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    python = (ROOT / ".venv-gpu/Scripts/python.exe").resolve()
    script = (ROOT / "experiments/closure_p3_disagreement_20261020.py").resolve()
    expected_args = [str(script), "infer", "--output", str(BASE / "run01"),
                     "--manifest", str(MANIFEST), "--max-seconds", "3500"]
    if (Path(command["executable"]).resolve() != python or command["arguments"] != expected_args
            or command["arguments_line"] != subprocess.list2cmdline(expected_args)):
        raise ValueError("registered infer command changed")
    return command


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--source-commit", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if len(args.source_commit) != 40 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in args.source_commit):
        parser.error("full lowercase archived source commit required")
    if any(path.exists() for path in (OUTER, INNER, WORKER.parent, EXECUTION)):
        parser.error("exclusive first-run outputs must not already exist")
    manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    before = source_hashes(manifest)
    command_identity()
    powershell = (Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe").resolve()
    if not powershell.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(powershell)
    ps = (ROOT / "experiments/native_process_receipt_20261020.ps1").resolve()
    native_command = [str(powershell), "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                      "-File", str(ps), "-CommandJson", str(COMMAND),
                      "-WorkingDirectory", str(ROOT), "-Output", str(INNER),
                      "-TimeoutSeconds", "3570", "-MaxSeconds", "3600",
                      "-SourceCommit", args.source_commit, "-FixtureIdentityJson", str(WORKER)]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "experiments"))
    from fixed_edge_pair_20261019 import native_job
    record = {"status": "INCONCLUSIVE_NUMERICAL_OR_IMPLEMENTATION", "source_commit": args.source_commit,
              "source_before": before, "native_command": native_command,
              "native_outer_receipt": str(OUTER / "native.json"),
              "native_inner_receipt": str(INNER / "receipt.json"),
              "worker_identity": str(WORKER), "support_hold_seconds": 900}
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        outer = native_job(native_command, OUTER, 3600, worker_json=WORKER)
        record["outer"] = outer
        if (INNER / "receipt.json").is_file():
            record["inner"] = json.loads((INNER / "receipt.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if WORKER.is_file():
            record["worker"] = json.loads(WORKER.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        final = WORKER.parent / "final.json"
        if final.is_file():
            science = json.loads(final.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            record["scientific_result"] = {"status": science.get("status"),
                                            "row_count": len(science.get("rows", [])),
                                            "final_sha256": sha(final)}
        record["source_after"] = source_hashes(manifest)
        inner = record.get("inner", {})
        worker = record.get("worker", {})
        valid = (outer.get("status") == "COMPLETED" and outer.get("exit_code") == 0
                 and outer.get("native_receipt_complete") is True
                 and inner.get("status") == "COMPLETED" and inner.get("exit_code") == 0
                 and inner.get("native_receipt_complete") is True
                 and inner.get("cleanup_verified") is True and inner.get("timeout") is False
                 and inner.get("fixture_identity_after") == "GONE"
                 and isinstance(worker.get("pid"), int) and worker["pid"] > 0
                 and isinstance(worker.get("creation_filetime_utc"), int)
                 and worker["creation_filetime_utc"] > 0
                 and outer.get("actual_worker_pid") == worker["pid"]
                 and inner.get("fixture_pid") == worker["pid"]
                 and inner.get("fixture_creation_filetime_utc") == worker["creation_filetime_utc"]
                 and record.get("scientific_result", {}).get("row_count") == 366
                 and record.get("scientific_result", {}).get("status") in
                 ("ACTIVE_DESIGN_ADMISSIBLE", "NO_ACTIVE_DESIGN_ADMISSION"))
        record["status"] = "EXECUTION_COMPLETED" if valid else "INCONCLUSIVE_NUMERICAL_OR_IMPLEMENTATION"
    except BaseException as exc:
        record["error"] = repr(exc)
        record["traceback"] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        if "source_after" not in record:
            try:
                record["source_after"] = source_hashes(manifest)
            except BaseException as exc:
                record["source_after_error"] = repr(exc)
                record["status"] = "INCONCLUSIVE_NUMERICAL_OR_IMPLEMENTATION"
        record["launcher_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
        record["actual_wrapped_seconds"] = record.get("outer", {}).get("seconds")
        write_new(EXECUTION, record)
    print(json.dumps({"status": record["status"], "execution": str(EXECUTION),
                      "outer_receipt": record["native_outer_receipt"],
                      "inner_receipt": record["native_inner_receipt"],
                      "actual_wrapped_seconds": record["actual_wrapped_seconds"]}))
    return 0 if record["status"] == "EXECUTION_COMPLETED" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
